user_query: I'm organizing a company event and I want to include some anime-themed elements. Fetch quotes from various anime titles to display on screens throughout the venue. Additionally, provide me with a programming meme to share with my colleagues.

TaskList.description: Fetch quotes from various anime titles.
Select a programming meme to share with colleagues.
Combine anime quotes and programming meme into a presentation format.
Prepare and schedule the display of quotes and meme during the event.
